title: ShelfSense: Library Circulation
context: Libraries track issues and returns, compute fines, and must answer 'is this book on the shelf?' instantly at the counter.
input: Books sorted by accession number; issue records with day numbers; a category tree.

milestones.title: Double scans at the gate
milestones.requirement: Accession numbers scanned twice in one session (count array or set).

milestones.title: Category tree totals
milestones.requirement: Books per category in a nested category tree (post-order recursion).

milestones.title: Books out each day
milestones.requirement: Each issue [day, returnDay] adds 1 to a range: difference array gives books-out per day.

milestones.title: Keyword search
milestones.requirement: Count occurrences of a keyword in the catalogue text (KMP).

milestones.title: Find a book
milestones.requirement: Binary search the sorted accession numbers; report the insertion point when absent.

milestones.title: Return-counter queue
milestones.requirement: Students returning books queue at the counter; compare 1 and 2 staff.
